sources.snippet: Ultralytics YOLO26 is a unified family of real-time vision models described in the Ultralytics YOLO26 paper. It introduces native end-to-end inference, a lighter detection head, an updated training recipe, and task-specific heads for detection, segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection.
